reviews.x: I just received this shower brush last week and used it for the first time.  Wow, what a great brush! Excellent brush. Quality. Ordered a second one! The bristles are great and it really works.  Arrived timely and well packaged. The dual functionality is very useful.
This brush is a great addition to my shower.  This is a great company and will be using them a lot in my future.

reviews.x: I love my new bath brush. It is long enough to reach my feet and the bristles are sturdy but not sharp.
This brush is great, soft and holds soap for a great back scrub.I ordered another !

It is versatile, allowing me to utilize it with both the long handle (for those hard to reach places), and as a hand held brush to concentrate on my legs, knees, arms, and elbows.  This is my favorite bath accessory!  I simply love how it exfoliates my skin leaving me feeling silky smooth. This is one superior bath brush made out of natural bristles with a real wooden handle.   I bought this brush a couple years ago and use it whenever bathing and when it was featured last week in the gold box, I bought a second one to have on the shelf.   My bath-life is better with this wonderful brush and I always want one around, my first one is in perfect condition after a couple years of active use, so number two is on the shelf in case I need this perfect brush called to duty.

I would honestly recommend anyone looking for a good scrub brush. The handle is long enough to reach the middle of my back, and the bristles are perfect  . You can not go wrong with their 30 day money back guarantee. And it is great on the skin makes it nice and smooth, I bought this brush because it had good reviews and great quality. Remember money back guaranteed. This my second purchase but my first review...

Just what I was looking for.  The nylon bristle brushes are too harsh, but these natural bristles are perfect for that satisfying back scrub!  It is a better finished product than the last one I purchased at a major discount chain.  Update:  After 6 1/2 months, the brush has begun to come apart. The plastic backing holding the bristles began to crack and separate from the wood portion.  Out of warranty.

The brush arrived with cracks in the plastic part holding the bristles in place, so they will be coming out of the brush soon if used.  The clear plastic cover was also crushed therefore smashing the bristles so they won't stand back up.  The box the brush was shipped in was not damaged so the brush had to be damaged prior to shipping.  I will be returning this brush.  Very disappointed.

Good multi use bath brush.  It has a removable handle so it can be used to reach places on the back  but also as hsndheld brush for legs and arms.  The  bristles are nto too  soft and not too stiff or scratchy. The only thing I con't like is the elastic on the hand brush is not very sturdy ot tight enough to be much help, so I have to grasp the actual brush.  Still, I'm glad I bought it.

reviews.t: Bristles are pretty firm. I'm no sissy
reviews.x: Built well.  Bristles are pretty firm.  I'm no sissy, and I can take the firm bristles, I guess it's good for exfoliating, if that matters, but it does not feel as good as softer ones I've used.  Some people like that sort of thing, I suppose. Probably people with thick, African wildebeest like skin.  What ever.  I like that the handle comes off and becomes a hand brush.

I love this brush, it is firm without being rough and has not caused any issues with my very, very delicate skin.  I think it has improved my lymphatic flow and has made  many of the unsightly bruises I have on my forearms dissipate faster.  I would definitely buy this again when this one wears out which I don't think will be for a long time.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the bristles as being just right—neither too soft nor too rough—and effective for exfoliating and scrubbing.
Many customers appreciate the long, detachable handle that makes it easy to reach the middle of the back and other hard-to-reach areas.
Several reviewers were so satisfied that they ordered a second brush or recommended it to others.
A few reviewers report quality problems such as missing bristles, splintering, cracks, or the brush coming apart over time.
A small number of reviewers found the brush not worth the trouble or noticed no benefit from using it.
